raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: Scan the structure from left to right. Count every displayed bond between non-hydrogen atoms and do not count any curved arrow. The non-H bonds are C-R1, C-R2, central C-N, N-C(=O), C=O, C-O, central C-C of the nitrile substituent, and C≡N. Add these eight heavy-atom bond connections to obtain 8.

method.method_draft: Break the drawing into fragments and count heavy-atom bonds per fragment. Around the central carbon: two R attachments plus the C-N attachment and the C-C attachment to the nitrile give 4 bonds. The N-to-carbonyl connection gives 1 more. The carbonyl/carboxyl group contributes C=O and C-O, giving 2 more. The nitrile group contributes C≡N as 1 more. Sum 4 + 1 + 2 + 1 = 8.

推理：按片段统计重原子之间的键，不计任何涉及氢的键，并将单键、双键、三键各作为一个键连接来计数。中心碳周围有 R¹-C、R²-C、C-N、C-C(腈基碳) 共 4 个键；N 到羰基碳有 1 个键；羰基/羧基部分有 C=O 和 C-O 共 2 个键；腈基 C≡N 计 1 个键。总数为 4 + 1 + 2 + 1 = 8。
